products.title: Champion Originals Lace Up Sneakers
products.description: These Keds Champion Originals sneakers are a timeless classic, first introduced in 1916 as one of the original rubber-soled canvas shoes. Loved for over a century by style icons and trendsetters, these lace-up sneakers offer enduring design and all-day comfort. Made with a canvas upper and a flexible, lightweight rubber outsole, they feature a soft, breathable textile lining and a 10% recycled PU foam footbed for added comfort. These sneakers are a versatile wardrobe essential that pairs well with any outfit.

products.title: JACK PURCELL CANVAS CLASSIC LOW TOP
products.description: The Converse Jack Purcell Canvas Classic Low Top is an iconic sneaker that has maintained its timeless design since the 1930s. This low-top shoe features a durable white canvas upper and lining, complemented by a rubber-wrapped midsole and a classic light-blue rubber outsole. For added comfort, it includes a removable EVA insert and medial-side air vent holes for improved breathability. The sneaker is finished with traditional metal eyelets and the signature Jack Purcell 'smile' on the toe cap.
